question: In which of the following North Eastern states is the first ever specialised ‘Ginger’ Processing Plant being revived in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In Meghalaya, the first-ever specialized ‘Ginger’ Processing Plant was revived in December 2020**__.

 
 
• North East’s first-ever specialized "Ginger" Processing Plant at district Ri-Bhoui in Meghalaya is being revived and is likely to become functional at the beginning of 2021.
 
• The only ginger processing plant of North-East India was established around 2004 but has remained non-functional for many years. 
 
• **The North Eastern Regional Agricultural Marketing Corporation (NERAMAC)** has undertaken the responsibility of reviving it and initiated steps to operationalize the closed plant through PPP mode. 
 
• The plant located at the **Export Promotion Industrial Park (EPIP), Raja Bhagan, Byrnihat Hatt** will not only process ginger but also help in preparing products such as waxed ginger, ginger paste, ginger powder, ginger flakes, ginger oil, among others. 
 
• For the PPP mode, an operation and maintenance operator was selected through the tendering process and the work on setting up and reviving the plant is under progress. 
 
• Moreover, the government has plans to set up **100 new fresh retail points** in the North-East and fruit kiosks at Guwahati and other major towns of the North-Eastern region.
